name: Hearth Charm
body:
School transmutation [fire]; Level druid/shaman 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target burning object
Duration see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Cast upon an object or material on fire, this spell slows the burning rate by half its normal speed, effectively doubling the time it can be used as fuel. If the object or material is not completely consumed within 24 hrs., it returns to normal.
